items.title: Joe Muranyi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: And she cornered me and said what did I want to play — would I like to join the band.

ctx.x: Are we on the air? TH: Yup.

So I did that, and I don’t remember particularly performing as performing, but I was taking these lessons, you know, maybe a couple of years of once a week or once every two weeks you know. And I did it and I don’t know what it cost but they had to pay money you know. And my father was not making a lot of money, it was Depression times you know. And then my father belonged to a lodge in the Bronx. We lived in the Bronx. And they had a band, a small band. And they were looking for recruits. So — what was her name,…
Yeah they needed a tuba, right?
